assumptions: 'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' is excluded because the camera cannot see it.
Stop is interpreted as remaining still (max_speed 0.05) continuously inside stop_zone, the near-side waiting area before stop_line.
No stop duration is stated, so 1000 ms of continuous still time is assumed to count as a stop.
Approaching is enforced only for vehicles that cross stop_line inbound; vehicles that never cross pass vacuously.
Inbound crossing from y<0.6 to y>0.6 (+y) is mapped to direction to_right per line definition.
No maximum time between stop and crossing is stated, so any prior stop before first crossing satisfies.
Anchor centre is used because top-down boxes use centre as metric position while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped still for at least 1000 ms inside the approach stop zone.

at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute gives no duration; 1000 ms chosen as minimum continuous still time to count as a stop.
Statute does not give detector direction; line definition maps inbound approach (y<0.6 to y>0.6, +y) to to_right.
Top-down boxes use centre as metric position and bottom_center is downstream AABB edge per line description, so centre is the point zones and lines were drawn for.
No max interval between stop and crossing is stated, so any prior stop satisfies.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
